bugs.summary: Not tested on a real SMART Board, a real phone or real teachers. Only desktop Chrome with demo data.
Library and Presentations browser popups and parts inside a few widget settings sheets still use the older look.
Hebrew and Yiddish text is an unreviewed draft. Newer strings (schedule, links, widget sheets) fall back to English.
The Large interface size does not scale the older modal windows.
The guest-to-account merge was verified by code reading and a restore test, not by an end-to-end sign-in with a real new account.
There is no automated test suite in the repository. Tests so far were ad hoc browser scripts.

note: Only non-sensitive items are published here.
